## getKeyRecordStatus() function

Look up the stored status of a key id.

Reads only the revocation column, so it is cheap enough to run on every validation. It always reads the database; validation's per-process cache sits in front of it.

This reports a stored record's status; it is not an authorization check. A key may be used only when its token also verifies, which `validateApiKey` decides.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function getKeyRecordStatus(keyId: string): KeyRecordStatus
```
